sql: CREATE TABLE audit_left(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,k INT)
CREATE TABLE audit_right(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,k INT,n INT)
SELECT a.id,b.id AS bid FROM audit_left a LEFT JOIN audit_right b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY a.id,b.id NULLS FIRST
SELECT a.id,b.id AS bid FROM audit_left a FULL JOIN audit_right b ON a.k=b.k ORDER BY a.id NULLS FIRST,b.id NULLS FIRST
SELECT id FROM audit_left a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_right b WHERE b.k=a.k) ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM audit_left a WHERE k NOT IN(SELECT k FROM audit_right) ORDER BY id
SELECT a.id,(SELECT MAX(b.n) FROM audit_right b WHERE b.k=a.k) AS m FROM audit_left a ORDER BY a.id
SELECT a.k,COUNT(b.id) AS n,SUM(b.n) AS total FROM audit_left a LEFT JOIN audit_right b ON a.k=b.k GROUP BY a.k ORDER BY a.k NULLS FIRST
